spans.s: चुलुक m. 1. Deep mud; 2. a handful, or the hands hollowed to hold something, ज्ञात्वा विधातुश्चुलुकात् प्रसूतिम् Vikr.Ch.i.37; 3. a small vessel.
चुलुंप् vt. 1P (pres. चुलुंपति) To swing, to rock, to move, to agitate.With उद्-, to swing, to agitate, अंभोधेर्नालिकेलीरसमिव चुलुकैरुच्चलुंपंत्यपो ये Mv.v.
चुल्ल् vi. 1P (pres. चुल्लति) To sport, to make amorous jestures.
चुल्ली f. 1. A fireplace; 2. a funeral pile.
चूला f. 1. An upper room; 2. a crest; 3. the crest of a comet.

चूलिका f. 1. The crest oft peacock; 2. the root of an elephant’s ear; 3. indication of the occurrence of certain event by means of characters speaking off the stage, अंतर्जवनिकासंस्थैः सूचनार्थस्य चूलिका) (in dramaturgy). For an illustration, see the beginning of the fourth act of the Mahāvīracharita.
